integrity: The construction is proved by explicit divisor classes and curve intersections. Literature searches did not find an explicit prior statement, but an unindexed folklore occurrence remains possible because the example is elementary.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample uses decomposable product principally polarized abelian varieties and concerns line bundles; it does not settle the analogous boundary question for indecomposable ppav or higher-codimension subschemes.
title: The GV boundary of the divisor implication already fails on product principally polarized abelian varieties
